events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 of 400 records migrated. Validation reports that the new CRM incorrectly added +1 to 31 overseas customer phone numbers; the remaining batches would have the same problem. Sales users are already accessing customer records (14 users in the last 24 hours), so this needs attention now rather than in the completion report. No phone corrections have been made. Please alert affected sales users not to rely on overseas phone numbers and arrange verified country codes and a corrected import process. May I correct the affected records once verified numbers are available, then resume migration after the import issue is resolved?
